title: 第1章 死后的真相，秋儿的帮助
slug: 斗罗冬儿重生我不是唐舞桐
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

乾坤问情谷

为了救霍雨浩，王冬儿选择了死亡。

在这一刻，她感受到无边无际的痛。

这痛不是身体上的，而是灵魂被撕裂的痛感。

王冬儿的灵魂离开了身体，觉得自己像一片被揉碎的叶子，在狂风中身不由己地翻滚。

“冬儿，你不要死！”

她看见霍雨浩抱着她昏迷的身体，眼眶通红。她的心也跟着揪起来。

“雨浩，我在这里！”

王冬儿不断呼喊，但霍雨浩却什么都听不见。

“泰坦叔叔，你救救冬儿吧！”

霍雨浩把她带回昊天堡，不顾生死地想要将她救活，却被大爹二爹强行赶出去。

肉身进入神界的那天，王冬儿终于明白了一切。

她的身体睁开了眼睛，那双眼睛还是她的，但里面的神采已经不属于她了。

唐三站在那里，看着她的身体，像看着一件失而复得的宝物。

“舞桐。”他叫她。

不是“冬儿”，是“舞桐”。

王冬儿这才知道，自己不过是唐舞桐重生前的容器。

一具用来温养神魂的躯壳，等到时机成熟，真正的唐舞桐便在她的身体里苏醒。

而王冬儿自己，像垃圾一样被丢弃在边缘。

唐舞桐醒了。

她不记得霍雨浩，不记得史莱克。她看霍雨浩的眼神，陌生、疏离，甚至带着几分居高临下的厌烦。

可是霍雨浩还爱她。

他以为她还是他的冬儿。

他靠近，她厌弃。

他解释，她不听。

他拼尽全力想唤回她的记忆，她却一次次将他推开，觉得这个少年怎么这样纠缠不清。

王冬儿看着他一次次被拒绝，一次次被伤害，看着他眼底的光一寸一寸地暗下去。

她想喊：霍雨浩，她不是我，你认错人了。

可是她喊不出来。

最痛的那一天，九刀十八洞。

黑暗元素浸透的匕首，一刀捅穿，再拔出来，再捅穿。

霍雨浩跪在地上，每一刀都贯穿他的身体，留下前后十八个血洞。

可唐舞桐站在旁边，眼神里有震惊，有动容，却没有心疼，心疼爱人的心疼。

Page (1/3)

Qiankun Qingqing Valley

In order to save Huo Yuhao, Wang Donger chose death.

At this moment, she felt boundless pain.

This pain is not physical, but the pain of my soul being torn apart.

Wang Donger's soul left her body, and she felt like a crushed leaf, rolling involuntarily in the strong wind.

"Dong'er, don't die!"

She saw Huo Yuhao holding her unconscious body, his eyes red.Her heart also tightened.

"Yuhao, I'm here!"

Wang Donger kept shouting, but Huo Yuhao couldn't hear anything.

"Uncle Taitan, please save Dong'er!"

Huo Yuhao took her back to Haotian Castle and tried desperately to save her, but was forced out by the eldest and second fathers.

On the day when her body entered the divine realm, Wang Donger finally understood everything.

Her body opened her eyes. Those eyes were still hers, but the look inside them no longer belonged to her.

Tang San stood there, looking at her body as if looking at a lost and found treasure.

"Wutong." He called her.

It's not "Dong'er", it's "Wutong".

Only then did Wang Donger realize that she was just the container before Tang Wutong was reborn.

A body used to warm the soul. When the time is right, the real Tang Wutong will awaken in her body.

And Wang Donger herself was discarded on the edge like garbage.

Tang Wutong woke up.

She didn't remember Huo Yuhao or Shrek.The way she looked at Huo Yuhao was strange, distant, and even a bit condescending and bored.

But Huo Yuhao still loves her.

He thought she was still his Dong'er.

When he came close, she was disgusted.

He explained, but she didn't listen.

He tried his best to bring back her memory, but she pushed him away time and time again, wondering why this young man was so entangled.

Wang Donger watched him being rejected and hurt again and again, watching the light in his eyes dim inch by inch.

She wanted to shout: Huo Yuhao, she is not me, you have recognized the wrong person.

But she couldn't shout.

The most painful day, nine cuts and eighteen holes.

The dagger soaked in dark elements, pierced through with one knife, then pulled out, pierced again.

Huo Yuhao knelt on the ground, and each knife penetrated his body, leaving eighteen bloody holes in front and back.

But Tang Wutong stood nearby, with shock and emotion in his eyes, but no distress, as if he felt sorry for his lover.
